children: HyOrc received a notice on October 21, 2026, from OnEnergy purporting to discontinue HyOrc's participation in a proposed Bulgarian waste-to-methanol project under an agreement dated March 23, 2026. OnEnergy cited the parties' unsuccessful joint grant application; HyOrc disputes the validity of the purported termination and says the contractual conditions have not been established. HyOrc has reserved its contractual and intellectual property rights and remains open to resolving the dispute. No exit fees or payments were disclosed.
